title: Light and Sound Lab · Q4 W07 D02
objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.
introduction: Milo hits a drum — boom! And outside, sunlight helps the plants grow. How do light and sound help us?

items.explanation: Striking the drum makes its top vibrate, and that makes sound. Sponges, towels, and pillows make no sound when struck.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?

options.text: move away from very loud sounds

items.explanation: Very loud sound can hurt your ears, so moving away from it keeps your hearing safe.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: name a color in the room
do not look directly at a bright light
count the books on a shelf

items.explanation: A very bright light can hurt your eyes, so never look straight at one.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a drum makes sound when struck
a lamp lights a dark room

items.explanation: Striking the drum makes it vibrate, and that makes sound. Lamps, flashlights, and mirrors are about light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a drum makes sound when struck

items.explanation: Sunlight gives plants the light energy they need to grow. Bells, drums, and claps make sound.
